_meta.purpose: Layout Policy Schema: declarative, configurable policy mapping (input conditions -> layout decisions). NOT hardcoded if/else.
_meta.scope: Policy owns the DECISION of spatial allocation given content/device/context conditions. It is consumed by Planner to produce a Layout Directive.
_meta.key_principle: Aspect Ratio -> Layout Policy -> Layout Variant -> Layout Directive. Policies are data, swappable and extensible without code changes.
_meta.relationship: Policy is the decision layer between Page Model (intent) and Template/Skeleton (structure). Multiple page types can share one policy (e.g. media-ratio-policy serves media-detail, media-editor, preview pages).

field_specs.input: conditions the policy reads (aspect_ratio, metadata_size, title_length, device, ...)
